title: Handbook of the Breath-Carried Club
summary: Teaches Senior students to lend breath and qi to the club's swing and to hold a pressing brace.

title: Lessons in the Joint-Breaking Club
summary: Trains the student to aim qi-tipped club blows at elbows and knees to break an opponent's joints.

title: Canon of the Pendulum Cudgel
summary: Shows how qi feeds the swinging arc of a cudgel so each stroke gathers weight and speed.

title: The Rebounding Club Workbook
summary: Drills students in turning a club's rebound off parries and targets into the next qi-driven blow.

title: Treatise on the Club Against Reaching Weapons
summary: Teaches a club fighter to enter past spear and pole points, bind the shaft, and strike inside.

title: Drill-Book of the Qi-Struck Knot
summary: Drills the gnarled head of a club as a striking point, a hook and a prod, charged with qi.

title: Manual of the Cudgel and the Open Hand
summary: Joins the open hand to the cudgel so that palm, sleeve grab and club blow work as one exchange.

title: Handbook of the Staggering Blow
summary: Teaches heavy qi-backed club blows meant to rock an opponent off balance rather than to wound.

title: A Longer Canon of the Bruising Club
summary: Collects the strikes, shoves and rhythms by which a club wears down muscle and the will to fight.
